Nothing in bg3.exe writes it: the only users are the type registration bg3.exe+0x2EA310 and the generic helpers bg3.exe+0x21DB110 / bg3.exe+0x2E9A120 - the creator must be outside the code base the index sees (Osiris/scripting or an engine helper) or it is unused in this build. fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Registry size 8. Windows: bg3.exe+0x2E9A120 registers the query (DAT_1463958C4) of esv::thrown::AttachmentSystem with eoc::thrown::AttachComponent and this one-frame component; its gather step bg3.exe+0x2E97160 (lines 281-290) reads an 8-byte value (stride 8) from the query's one-frame column (index field +0x54, the slot one-frame components use) and stores it as the request's entity, as the Toolkit GatherRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x3DACC0) does before ProcessAttachmentRequests copies it into eoc::thrown::AttachComponent+0 (an EntityHandle per its replication serializer). No writer in bg3.exe (filled by Osiris/scripting or unused).

second_pass: The Windows gather step of esv::thrown::AttachmentSystem (bg3.exe+0x2E97160, query registered by bg3.exe+0x2E9A120) reads the 8 bytes of this one-frame component as the entity of an attach request, matching the Toolkit GatherRequests.
